### 2026-10-16 – # Starting Work On My Very Own Marble Run!

**2.02h**

# Starting Work On My Very Own Marble Run!

Today, I finally had enough time to start working on my week two project! I was waiting for this day **all week**, and I'm excited to see what I end up making!

![download](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/58bf1c71bfced9b959b70eea4955f55ec33dfdfd3d8d13ce8eb29fbfd6e0c32c.jpg)

# Starting My Session
I started by choosing Merbl run, the starting project for week two. I could have done my own project, but I wanted to learn new CAD tools! I went through the guide, but I was able to skip a few steps, since I have done alot of Onsahpe before for FRC.

![images](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/7045c203e851291c7eec72372f4801154c462540aaafc6bf389c1f59c3bd85a2.png)
Ma team

[Guide](https://docs.github.com)

# During
I went through the instructions pretty fast, but I soon quickly realized that this was not what I learned for FRC. It did take some time; I ended up trying a lot of the strategies today, and I was even able to figure out how to make a spiral!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/d8ee57502e0309d04d8e970cf795ab91bfb4c6807d8f0bd907b7daf683221c58.png)

After a lot of testing, tomorrow I'm going to design my Marble Run before I start CADding, so I have something to base it on instead of random things everywhere.

### 2026-10-17 – # Locking in

**2.58h**

# Locking in

Today is probably the most important session for this whole project! I worked on the bulk of the design, and I'm almost done the actual CAD!

# Design

I started by creating a Canva Whiteboard to come up with a couple ideas for my track.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/e0344651cd8eee58785d555909cb15eb060be0b3fec3bc6500e7857f771db903.png)

I was going to go for a motorized automated system, but I didn't have the knowledge to integrate it into my model, so I kept it simple instead.

# CAD
I used what I learned yesterday and started drawing up my tracks for my Marble Run. I had a lot of trouble figuring out how to connect my tracks together, but I evantually figuered it out.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/d5ada403471e096e6a2f39803268397061d6b5dee37bb85d837f35d829a054a1.png)

Then I worked on the wall:

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/950f6039f62381e4b18cf048310fb8e179a4cc6953017cf7e5f6f5adf2ea094e.png)

Then finished up the day with a middle pillar and more tracks!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/877aee1152628a8417a2a0d0cfb979b686602ec4f0ef3d9a1218a16363b362a6.png)

# What's Next?

I'm planning on adding a spiral track on the right of my base, and connecting it to where my marbles are going to connect. Then I'm going to polish (chamfer, fillet) **everything** and constrain **all my sketches** too.

* LOT'S OF WORK AHEAD OF ME!
